description_en: Creates a backup for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
name: CreateBackup

parameters.help_en:
The backup method of the instance. Valid values:
Snapshot: snapshot backup.
Logical: logical backup.
Physical (default): physical backup.

Cloud disk instances support only snapshot backups.
Only replica set and sharded cluster instances support selecting a backup method. For standalone instances, you do not need to specify this parameter, and snapshot backup is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
实例的备份方式，取值：
Snapshot：快照备份。
Logical：逻辑备份。
Physical（默认值）：物理备份。

云盘版实例仅支持快照备份。
仅副本集和分片集群实例支持选择备份方式。单节点实例无需传入本参数，固定为快照备份
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en: The backup note. It cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The value must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 备份备注，不能以http://或https://开头；可包含英文大小写字母/中文/数字/下划线(_) /短横线 (-)，长度为2-256个字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of the backup. This parameter is applicable only to cloud disk replica set and cloud disk sharded cluster instances.

If you do not specify this parameter, the retention period remains the same as that in the default backup policy. Valid values: 
7 to 730: The backup is retained for 7 to 730 days.
-1: The backup is permanently retained
parameters.help_zh:
备份保留天数，只适用于云盘副本集与云盘分片集群实例。

不传表示和默认的备份策略保持一致。传递时，可传 
7-730天
-1 （长久保留）
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

BackupId.description_en:
The ID of the backup.

[Deprecated] This parameter will be deprecated soon. To obtain the backup ID, call the [DescribeBackups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468441.html） operation
BackupId.description_zh:
备份ID。

该参数即将下线，如需获取备份ID，请调用[DescribeBackups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468441.html）接口获取

BackupJobId.description_en: The ID of the backup job
